items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: He had the Johnson band. Oh, yeah, yeah. I went up there and played with them a while

ctx.x: That's like Kid Victor. I don't know his right name. Yeah. From Baton Rouge.

And all the rest of them fellas I know, they did. And you say, have a fella there that had a band that played trombone named Stuart. Stuart, yeah, yeah. And then they had a Stuart premiere, used to play trumpet. Yeah. He went up there, but I went up there and played with them a while, you know, until I got ready to come home. He had the Johnson band. Oh, yeah. Yeah.
Well, I wanted to tell you.
